news.headline: Cloudflare CEO: Agent Traffic Will Be “a Thousand Times Human Traffic.” Its Pricing Has to Change
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCloudflare CEO Matthew Prince said on TBPN that agent traffic could reach a thousand times human traffic within five years if current trends continue. He expects agents to pay a tiny fee each time they access a page, and Cloudflare has already released a gateway that lets sites collect those payments.
